'A batch holds one currency only' does not clearly cover cash vs bet credit, because the ticket treats payout type and currency as separate attributes. The cash/bet credit separation is a real gap.
The split primary/secondary paid flag (L3158) is a soft Kobi proposal, not a firm client decision.
Additional drift (Sep 30, L3352): the secondary bonus is to be automated, but WAGR-465 says the system does not create the Payout automatically.
